verdict.rationale: MailerLite's API documents drafting, scheduling, and cancelling campaigns. An agent can reach it through MailerLite's MCP integration or Claude connector and leave a campaign as a draft or scheduled for a human to review. Segments exist as a product feature, but the evidence does not show the API targeting a segment when creating a campaign, and there is no explicit approval gate. Missing for 10: documented segment targeting on API-created campaigns, an explicit human-approval or review-queue workflow before send, hands-on corroboration of the agent drafting flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send
